## Kindle Custom Screensaver v0.3.0

Kindle Custom Screensaver displays custom PNG sleep screens on jailbroken Kindles while retaining the stock reading experience. This release adds Kindle Package Manager (KPM) installation and lifecycle support while keeping the existing ZIP installation available.

### Changes

* Publishes a `kindlehf` KPM package and self-hosted KPM repository manifest with each release
* Adds KPM install, launch, upgrade, and uninstall hooks
* Stops the custom screensaver safely before upgrades or removal
* Preserves `/mnt/us/screensavers/` and all custom images during upgrades and uninstall
* Uses the same staged runtime files for the ZIP and KPM packages
* Validates the KPM archive layout, manifest metadata, package version, supported platform, executable hooks, and generated repository metadata in CI

The ZIP package remains available with the same installation layout as previous
releases.

### KPM installation

Add the release repository and refresh KPM's package index:

```text
;kpm add-repo https://kpm.andrecheng.com/kpm.json
# or ;kpm add-repo https://github.com/chengandre/kindle-custom-screensaver/releases/latest/download/kpm-repository.json
;kpm update
```

Then install the package:

```text
;kpm install custom-screensaver
```

After installation, upload your PNG screensaver images to the Kindle's
`/screensavers/` folder.

KPM packaging and lifecycle support are implemented, but still require
physical-device validation.

### ZIP installation

Download:

`custom-screensaver-0.3.0-kindlehf.zip`

Extract it on your computer, then copy the included `documents`, `extensions`,
and `screensavers` contents to the corresponding folders on your Kindle.

See the README for full KPM and ZIP installation, update, and uninstall
instructions.
